title: Project 5
learning_outcomes_intro: After successfully completing the module, students will be able to

items: gain experience working professionally on a project in a team.
understand professional project management including economic considerations.
can apply the skills and knowledge acquired in the other modules so far.
can analyse and detect interesting technical and economic opportunities of an immersive media application or game.
can professionally design, create and present an interactive, immersive application or game.
can evaluate application e.g., by conducting user tests and recommend improvements.
Professional design and creation of a complex interactive application
Practical application of various skills acquired in previous modules
Consideration and calculation of professional publishing, marketing, monetization, quality assurance

reading_list.reference: Depending on subject of study and task.
